source_description: Spec Kitty has changed a LOT since we wrote outside-in, adversarial functional and integration tests. You need to thoroughly inspect ../spec-kitty code for changes since the last commit in this repo. In particular, we've rolled back a feature we were building, and that is jujutsu support (jj): Phase 1: Core VCS Detection - detection.py: Disabled jj detection by making is_jj_available() always return False, making get_jj_version() always return None, commenting out jj auto-detection in get_vcs(), simplifying error messages to only mention git. Phase 2: Command Updates - init.py: Removed --vcs flag and updated _detect_default_vcs() to only return git, simplified _display_vcs_info() to show only git messaging, updated _save_vcs_config() to hardcode git configuration. implement.py: Modified _ensure_vcs_in_meta() to always lock to git for new features, automatically convert features with legacy jj locks to git, display conversion warning message. sync.py & ops.py: Simplified messaging to only show git backend. merge.py: Removed jj colocated mode reference. Phase 3: Documentation - Deleted 5 jj-specific documentation files. Updated CLAUDE.md: Removed the entire jj Integration section. Updated config.yaml: Simplified VCS config to only git. Updated template: Removed jj reference from implement.md. Phase 4: Tests - test_detection.py: Updated 6 tests to expect jj detection disabled. test_implement_command.py: Updated 2 tests to reflect jj-to-git conversion. test_init_command.py: Updated VCS tests to remove jj expectations, deleted 3 tests for --vcs flag (feature removed). Key Features: VCS abstraction layer still available (for potential future use), backwards compatibility with features with jj locks auto-convert to git, clean error messages when jj is requested, all 57 core VCS/implement tests pass, sparse checkouts now work correctly (no jj colocated issues). Make a spec for comprehensive testing of the current spec kitty, covering the entire delta since we last tested here
